name: collaborative-code-editor
description: Real-time collaborative code editor with React, Express, Prisma, JWT auth, and Yjs CRDT sync.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @collab-code/api && npm run build -w @collab-code/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @collab-code/api && npm run test -w @collab-code/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @collab-code/api && npm run typecheck -w @collab-code/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @collab-code/api && npm run typecheck -w @collab-code/web
